question: Will Ostium be subject to a class action lawsuit before the end of 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if a class action lawsuit naming Ostium (including Ostium Foundation, Ostium Labs Co., or any substantially similar Ostium entity) as a defendant is filed in any court, and that filing occurs strictly after 2026-10-01T21:56:26.529Z and at or before 2027-01-01T08:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if no such class action lawsuit filing against Ostium is confirmed to have occurred strictly after 2026-10-01T21:56:26.529Z and at or before 2027-01-01T08:00:00.000Z.

Clarifications:
- A "class action lawsuit" is a lawsuit filed on behalf of a putative class of plaintiffs (e.g., a complaint explicitly styled as a class action or a putative class action); a petition to compel arbitration or an individual suit does not qualify, even if it involves multiple parties.
- The filing date of the complaint (as recorded by the court's docket) determines whether the event falls within the window.
